class_id: a lower-ranked source, or a failed/unknown read of the top-ranked one, releases or overwrites an admin hold, so the value the admin rejected comes back
feature: packages/shared/src/services/exchange-override-rule.ts (decideExchangeOverride) + exchange-override.ts (applyExchangeOverride), the one system path that releases an admin hold on an E-1 field (OD-106, OD-117, OD-141, spec section 9.2 item 28(a))
symptom: Any rule that lets a source other than the highest-ranked source that states the field release an admin hold re-opens the field to the normal walk, which asks the ranks in order and writes the top-ranked answer. When the top-ranked source still states the value the admin rejected (or its read failed this pass and succeeds next pass), that rejected value is written back. The shape generalises beyond exchanges: a release decision and the writer that runs after it must use the same rank order, and 'rank 1 did not answer' must never be read as 'rank 1 has nothing to say'. Round 4 widened it: any answer that is not an explicit 'not printed' (a not-found, an ambiguous match, an empty board from a scraper that swallows its own failure) must be UNKNOWN; reading it as 'stated nothing' records a null baseline, and the source's next good read then looks 'newer' and releases the hold.
first_seen: 2026-09-29, Tier A review round 3 of the OD-106 build (branch feat/od106-exchange-replaces-admin-date, 571990327; parked as #1287). Probe on the real path: NSE CHECK_FAILED and BSE moving to 2026-10-05 released the hold (REPLACE from BSE); the next walk (close_date ranks NSE, BSE, CHITTORGARH) would write NSE's 2026-10-01, the date the admin had rejected. Reproduced in this change: with the round-3 rule swapped back in, 5 of the 6 OD-141 integration cases fail on ipodhan_test, e.g. 'expected 2026-10-05 to be 2026-10-03' (BSE released the admin date). Earlier rounds of the same class: round 1 kept legacy holds with no exchangeAtSave forever; round 2 wrote 'no stored answer' as 'stated nothing' at the save path. Round 4 (Tier A, 2026-09-30, CRITICAL-1): scrapeNSEIPOs returns ipos: [] on total failure and the NSE fetcher answered NOT_AVAILABLE_YET (also for an ambiguous match); the rule treated NOT_AVAILABLE_YET as 'stated nothing' and recorded NSE: null, so on a legacy hold (previous_source CHITTORGARH) walk 2 NSE stating its pre-save 2026-07-10 released the admin's 2026-06-29. Reproduced in this change: with NOT_AVAILABLE_YET put back as 'stated nothing', 3 of 7 OD-145 integration cases fail on ipodhan_test.
fix_prs: feat/od141-top-ranked-exchange-releases (OD-141, owner 2026-09-29): only the highest-ranked exchange that states the field may release; a failed / CHECK_FAILED / non-date / withdrawn top-ranked read keeps the admin value; a lower-ranked exchange's newer value becomes one admin-queue disagreement (data_conflicts, deduped by suggestion_key) instead of a release; admin EMPTY follows the same rule. Round 5 (OD-145, owner 2026-09-30): only NOT_PRINTED is 'stated nothing'; NOT_AVAILABLE_YET, CHECK_FAILED and FAILED are UNKNOWN, keep the admin value, record no baseline and never hand the decision down; the NSE fetcher answers CHECK_FAILED for an empty board and an ambiguous match; the admin-save evidence prefers the exchange's own current value over a stored 'nothing'; the queue key includes the admin value; item 9 runs only while the hold stands (composeHeldFieldHooks).
detection_check: CI gate, not a runtime audit: packages/shared/src/services/exchange-override-rule.test.ts (OD-141 block) and scraper/tests/integration/exchange-override-od106.integration.test.ts (listed in pr-gate.yml; the OD-141 cases run the real walk, the production hold deps and the override transaction on ipodhan_test). Mutation-checked: letting rank 2 decide when rank 1 FAILED, withdrew or gave a non-date, or when the admin value is EMPTY, each turns tests red; round 5 adds NOT_AVAILABLE_YET-as-nothing, empty-board-as-not-found (scraper/tests/unit/services/field-plan-walk-nse-fetcher.test.ts), unknown-rank-1-hands-off, dedupe key without the admin value, and item 9 after a release (scraper/tests/unit/services/exchange-override-hook.test.ts). No runtime check yet: the release's audit row carries details.releaseRule 'OD-141' and details.source, so a nightly check 'Exchange Override audit rows whose source is not rank 1 of the IPO's segment for that field' is possible and unbuilt.
